decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The Malaysian answer matches “older stepbrother,” but Indonesian saudara tiri laki-laki identifies a male stepbrother without encoding that he is older. The original broad cue “stepbrother” fit both more accurately. Also, saudara tiri can overlap with “half-sibling” in Malay usage, so a false-friend note is warranted. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
